svg.aria-label: Install, paste, see. A sleepy grey robot gets a skill cartridge labelled SKILL.md dropped into its head and wakes up blue with a red pen. It eats a sheet of paper covered in green slop blobs, the blobs fly out and burst, and it hands back a clean sheet with a green check.
